status: declared (unscored); binds from its git commit time, which must precede the first run
tier: Report-only external held-out check. No training, tuning, selection or adoption on any Juelich row. No number of record can change. Never pooled with FSRI, MaCFP, exp054 or any other external set.
declared: 2026-10-10 by Claude (Arnav's session) before any HRR value of the 24 files was read. Only file names, column headers and line counts were looked at (24 files; 12 Black, 12 Transparent; 25/35/50/75 kW/m2 x R1-R3).
what: Score the deployed pHRR record model models/v2/phrr_hgb_v4.joblib (exp074 recipe, 191-row FSRI fit, 10 features) on the peak HRR of 24 independent cone tests of 6 mm black and transparent PMMA from Forschungszentrum Juelich (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.6301397, CC BY 4.0; De Lannoye, Belt, Reinecke, Markert, Arnold; ASTM STP1642 2023).

source.files: data/sources/incoming/juelich_pmma_cone/{Black,Transparent}.zip (sha256 recorded in that folder's SOURCE.md; verified equal on 2026-10-10)
source.label: pHRR = max of the 'HRR (kW/m2)' column over the whole file, raw, unsmoothed, per test (same convention as FSRI 'Peak HRRPUA', exp054 and ASTM E1354). Time zero = shutter open. A 5-sample centred rolling-mean maximum is reported as a sensitivity column only, never as the label.
source.thickness: 6 mm for every test, from the public ASTM abstract (store.astm.org/stp164220210105.html: 'all tests were autoignition experiments and 6-mm-thick PMMA plates were used'). Not in the data files.
source.not_in_the_files: density, mass, MCC/TGA, ignition time. None is read from, or derived from, the Juelich files.

model_inputs.loader: data/v2/train_phrr_v3_robust.py: set EXTRAS to the baseline-corrected columns (total_hr_bc_kJg, t_onset_bc_C) exactly as its --bc flag does, then load(replicate_target=True). Take the first row of each matching material (all ten inputs other than heat_flux_kWm2 are material-level). Keep rows where has_mcc is true, as the record does. Check that this leaves 191 rows / 65 materials (the loader itself returns 221 rows before the filter; verified by row count only on 2026-10-10, before any label was read) and that the record model's .features equal PHYS+BASE order.
model_inputs.rule: Material-level inputs are FSRI measurements of the same material class, taken from the same tables the record was trained on. No input is tuned, imputed from a guess, or read from a Juelich label.
model_inputs.black_tests: FSRI Black_PMMA row of the record's feature frame: mcc_peak_hrr_Wg, mcc_char_yield_pct, mcc_total_hr_kJg, mcc_t_peak_C, mcc_t_onset_C (baseline-corrected columns, as in the record), log_kpc, density_kgm3.
model_inputs.transparent_tests: FSRI PMMA (clear cast) row, same columns. Black_PMMA is NOT used for the transparent tests.
model_inputs.variant_A_primary: geometry override: cone_thickness_mm = 6.0; cone_mass_per_area_kgm2 = 6.0e-3 x density_kgm3 of the matching FSRI material; heat_flux_kWm2 = the test's nominal flux.
model_inputs.variant_B_sensitivity: no override: FSRI's own cone_thickness_mm and cone_mass_per_area_kgm2 for the matching FSRI material.
model_inputs.stop_if: either matching FSRI material is missing any of the 10 inputs other than log_kpc of FSRI PMMA (see amendment_2): no fallback to the other material, no imputation; write a blocker and stop.

procedure: 0. Executor refuses to run unless this file is committed (git log -1 -- path non-empty and working copy == HEAD). Verify both zip sha256 against SOURCE.md and that there are 24 files.
1. Load the model and FSRI inputs; print the exact input vectors per (color, flux) before any label is read.
2. Predict all 24 tests, both variants. Write predictions.
3. Only now read the labels (max HRR per file). Compute metrics. Write outputs.

metrics.primary: Pooled R2 over all 24 tests, variant A. Also MAE (kW/m2) and MAE as a percentage of the mean label.
metrics.secondary: R2 and MAE per color; per-flux mean predicted vs mean observed; the signed bias (mean pred minus mean obs) per color and per flux; variant B for all of the above; sensitivity label (rolling-mean max) for the primary only.
metrics.no_ci_claim: n = 24 tests in 8 (color, flux) cells with 3 replicates each; R2 pooled over replicates is dominated by the 8 cells. A material-bootstrap CI is not defined (two materials). Report the replicate spread instead: per-cell min, mean, max of the observed pHRR.

known_limits: Overlap with training: FSRI Black_PMMA and PMMA are in the 191-row training set. This is a new laboratory, new specimens and a new instrument for a material the model has seen, NOT an unseen material. Same standing as exp054.
All tests are auto-ignition (no pilot); FSRI tests are piloted. Not corrected.
Only two materials; per-material R2 is not defined.
never: refit, tune, select or adopt any model using a Juelich row or label
pool with any other external set or with FSRI
write 'beats SOTA', set comparable true, or compare to any bar; no number of record is touched
drop or re-weight any of the 24 tests after seeing a label
exit_triggers: a Juelich-derived R2 above 0.30 is NOT an exit trigger here (report-only, different protocol); but any contradiction with a number of record or a missing input is: write a blocker and stop
amendment_1: 2026-10-10, before any Juelich label was read: the first executor run stopped at the row-count gate because the config said the loader returns 191 rows; it returns 221 and the record uses the 191 with has_mcc true. Wording corrected above. No other change.
after: A fresh-context critic pass before any number is quoted outside the run log.
amendment_2: 2026-10-10, before any Juelich label was read: the second executor run stopped at the stop_if gate because FSRI PMMA (clear cast, used for the transparent tests) has log_kpc missing (no heat-flow-meter data for that material). Declared choice: log_kpc is passed as NaN for the transparent tests, exactly as the record's HistGradientBoosting model sees it for every FSRI training material without HFM data (native missing-value handling). It is NOT filled from Black_PMMA, from any other material, or by imputation. Black tests are unchanged (FSRI Black_PMMA has log_kpc 12.38). The report must say the transparent predictions carry this missing input. The other nine inputs for FSRI PMMA must be present or the run stops.
amendment_3_post_hoc: 2026-10-10, AFTER the labels were read (so it is post-hoc and label-informed; the as-published result stays the declared primary and is reported unchanged). The column 'HRR (kW/m2)' has maxima of 6-16, which cannot be kW/m2 for PMMA (MaCFP PMMA peaks in this repo: 379-757 at 25, 965-1237 at 50 kW/m2). The Zenodo description says HRR per unit area was computed with a surface area of 0.0088 m2, so the column behaves like total HRR in kW. Post-hoc variant U: label = column maximum / 0.0088, the documented area only, no fitted factor. Check that does not use any Dravix output: Juelich/0.0088 at 25 and 50 kW/m2 is 1.18x and 1.22x the MaCFP-lab medians (Juelich 25 kW/m2 range 696-756 sits inside MaCFP's 379-757). Variant U is exploratory: it was proposed after seeing that the predictions and the rescaled labels are of similar size, so it must not be read as a confirmatory test. Needs the dataset authors (De Lannoye / Arnold) to confirm the units; that email is a human action. No number of record is affected.
